prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a cinematic close-up shot of a modern stainless steel refrigerator, focusing on its digital control panel displaying a temperature of -18°C. The brand logo "IFB" is visible above the display. The refrigerator surface is sleek and slightly reflective, with a few round metallic buttons and a small paper note attached by a magnet. The left side of the frame is dominated by the refrigerator, while the right side is softly blurred, revealing the indistinct profile of a bearded person in warm, ambient lighting. The background features out-of-focus kitchen shelves with dishes and glassware, contributing to a cozy, lived-in atmosphere. The color palette is muted and natural, with cool metallic tones from the fridge contrasting against the warm, golden hues of the kitchen. The composition uses shallow depth of field to draw attention to the appliance, evoking a sense of everyday domestic life with a touch of modern sophistication.
